messages.subject: Few Questions regarding MaAslin Programming
parts:
Hello,

Thank you for taking the time to read this. I am curious about a couple other things underlying how MaAslin runs its analyses. 


1) Does MaAslin use a generalized linear model or is it a linear model? ( I am concerned with outliers and non normalized data)

2). How is the boosting done in MaAslin? Would you be able to provide us with a reference paper of how this is done and what it means?

3). Is the adjustment (i.e. Bonferoni or Benjamini Hochberg) for multiple statistical tests already done within the program or is it done by us once the results are generated?


Thank you,


Remi
